payload.label: Share of core funding from commercial property and lending
payload.note: The council's own prudential indicator, net commercial income against net revenue stream. It was 16% in 2021/22 and 4% in 2024/25. Two cautions the council's own tables make plain: it added a notional £1.755m of borrowing cost for properties bought between 2017 and 2020 into the later years, and the sum it divides by grew from £21.416m in 2021/22 to £29.032m in 2024/25. Both push the percentage down without anything changing on the ground.
